name: Icon
summary: One glyph set, one size scale, one stroke-per-size — so every icon reads as a single family.
lead: ONE shared element — <aha-icon> — renders every glyph from the system-* outline set, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Size and stroke are paired tokens the component derives together (12→1, 16→1.5, 24→2, 32→2.5), so callers can't desync them; colour inherits currentColor. Never mix a second icon set, never eyeball an off-grid size, never thicken the stroke for emphasis.

props.name: name
props.desc: Glyph from the system-* outline set (exact asset stem)

props.name: size
props.desc: On-grid box size; derives the paired stroke width

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name (role=img); omit for a decorative icon

props.name: decorative
props.desc: aria-hidden — for an icon that only repeats adjacent text

whenToUse.when: the default for all product-UI chrome, buttons, menus, list rows, status
a selected/active/on state — a solid glyph survives greyscale, so state never rides on colour alone
ONLY when the system-* set genuinely lacks a glyph — outline weight, matched to the family; never a second default set

opinion.note: Never mix two icon sets in one view, never a hand-rolled inline <svg>, never a legacy fill/multicolor glyph (chat, play, heart) beside system-*. Off-grid sizes (no 20px) have no paired line width and render blurry. Icon-only buttons need an aria-label (and a tooltip when the meaning isn't obvious).

codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM SVG → identical render in React and Vue. Size derives the stroke inside the component, so a call site physically can't pass an off-scale stroke. Colour flows through currentColor — set it on the wrapper, not the glyph.

selfCheck.label: state via fill variant, not stroke

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, so there is a single render (no per-framework roots). Asserts the size↔stroke pairing that is the core token rule: a 24px icon strokes at 2, a 16px icon at 1.5.
